en.s: The Battle of Cassano was fought in the Autumn of 1259 between Guelph and Ghibelline armies in Northern Italy. In 1259, Ezzelino da Romano and his Ghibelline army moved into Lombardy and besieged Orci Novi. However, the approach of the Guelph army forced Ezzelino to abandon the siege and cross the Oglio River. Joined by exiled nobles from Milan, the Ghibellines attempted to take the city of Monza by force but failed.

zh.s: 卡萨诺战役于1259年秋在意大利北部爆发，交战双方为归尔甫派和吉伯林派。1259年，埃泽利诺·达·罗马诺率吉伯林军队进入伦巴第并围攻奥尔奇诺维。归尔甫军队逼近后，埃泽利诺被迫撤围并渡过奥廖河。吉伯林军队随后与来自米兰的流亡贵族会合，试图强行攻占蒙扎，但未能成功。

en.s: After the assassination of Francisco Pizarro, in retaliation for his father's execution in 1538, Diego de Almagro II, El Mozo, continued to press claims as the rightful ruler of Peru and as leader of his father's supporters. His claims were largely unsuccessful, however, as Pizarro was succeeded as governor by Cristóbal Vaca de Castro, despite claims from his brother Gonzalo Pizarro, whose claims to join arms against the Almagristas and "El Mozo" largely remained unanswered.

zh.s: 弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗遇刺后，为报复其父于1538年被处决，迭戈·德·阿尔马格罗二世（昵称“小子”）继续声称自己是秘鲁的合法统治者和其父支持者的领袖。但他的主张大多未能实现：皮萨罗死后，克里斯托瓦尔·巴卡·德·卡斯特罗继任总督。其兄贡萨洛·皮萨罗曾主张武装对抗阿尔马格罗派和“小子”，但这一主张基本无人响应。

en.s: The siege of Smolensk was one of the first great events of the Russo-Polish War (1654–67). Smolensk, which had been under the rule of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth during 1404–1514 and since 1611, was besieged by a Russian-Cossack army in June 1654. The Polish garrison of the city (commanded by Smolensk Voivode Filip Obuchowicz) hoped to get reinforcements from the army of Janusz Radziwiłł (1612–1655), stationed in Orsha.

zh.s: 斯摩棱斯克围城战是俄波战争（1654—1667年）初期的重要战事之一。斯摩棱斯克曾于1404年至1514年及1611年后处于波兰立陶宛联邦统治下。1654年6月，俄军与哥萨克组成的联军开始围城。由斯摩棱斯克总督菲利普·奥布霍维奇指挥的波兰守军，希望扬努什·拉齐维乌率领、驻扎在奥尔沙的援军能够赶到。

en.s: The Battle of Żarnów was fought on September 16, 1655, between the forces of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, commanded by John II Casimir and the forces of the Swedish Empire, commanded by Charles X Gustav. The result ended with a Swedish victory.

zh.s: 扎尔努夫战役发生于1655年9月16日，交战双方是约翰二世·卡西米尔率领的波兰—立陶宛联邦军队和卡尔十世·古斯塔夫率领的瑞典帝国军队。瑞典军队获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Gdov in the Russo-Swedish War took place on September 16, 1657, in Gdov. The battle was a clear victory for Prince Ivan Khovansky of the Tsardom of Russia over Swedish Governor-General Count Magnus De la Gardie allowing the Russians to regroup after a brief resurgence of Swedish resistance.

zh.s: 格多夫战役发生于1657年9月16日俄瑞战争期间，地点在格多夫。俄罗斯沙皇国的伊万·霍万斯基亲王击败了瑞典总督马格努斯·德拉加迪伯爵，取得明显胜利，使俄军得以在瑞典抵抗短暂复燃后重新集结。

en.s: The siege of Bohus fortress (Swedish: Belägringen av Bohus fästning) occurred in 1676 during the early stages of the Scanian War when Norwegian general Ulrik Frederik Gyldenløve invaded Bohuslän and besieged Bohus fortress, retreating on 16 September after supplies dwindled and the Swedish commander in the fortress refused to surrender.

en.s: The Battle of Harlem Heights was fought during the New York and New Jersey campaign of the American Revolutionary War. The action took place in what is now the Morningside Heights and east into the future Harlem neighborhoods of northwestern Manhattan Island in what is now New York City on September 16, 1776. The Continental Army, under Commander-in-Chief General George Washington, Major General Nathanael Greene, and Major General Israel Putnam, totaling around 9,000 men, held a series of high ground positions in upper Manhattan. Immediately opposite was the vanguard of the British Army totaling around 5,000 men under the command of Major General Henry Clinton.

zh.s: 哈莱姆高地战役发生于美国独立战争纽约与新泽西战役期间。1776年9月16日，战斗发生在今天纽约市曼哈顿西北部的晨边高地及未来的哈莱姆社区东部。乔治·华盛顿总司令、纳撒内尔·格林少将和以色列·普特南少将率领约9000名大陆军士兵，占据曼哈顿上城的一系列高地阵地。对面是亨利·克林顿少将指挥的英军前锋部队，约有5000人。

en.s: The Battle of the Clouds (also known as the Battle of Warren, Battle of Whitehorse Tavern, or the Battle of Goshen) was an aborted engagement of the Philadelphia campaign of the American Revolutionary War on September 16, 1777, in the area surrounding present day Malvern, Pennsylvania. After the American defeat at the Battle of Brandywine, the British Army remained encamped near Chadds Ford. When British commander William Howe was informed that the weakened American force was less than ten miles (16 km) away, he decided to press for another decisive victory. George Washington learned of Howe's plans, and prepared for battle.

zh.s: 云层战役也称沃伦战役、白马酒馆战役或戈申战役，是美国独立战争费城战役期间一次未能打响的交战，发生于1777年9月16日，地点在今天宾夕法尼亚州马尔文附近。布兰迪万河战役中美军战败后，英军仍驻扎在查兹福特附近。英军司令威廉·豪得知兵力已经削弱的美军距离不到10英里（16公里），便决定继续进攻，争取再获一次决定性胜利。乔治·华盛顿得知豪的计划后，做好了迎战准备。

en.s: The siege of Savannah or the second battle of Savannah was an encounter of the American Revolutionary War (1775–1783) in 1779. The year before, the city of Savannah, Georgia, had been captured by a British expeditionary corps under Lieutenant-Colonel Archibald Campbell. The siege itself consisted of a joint Franco-American attempt to retake Savannah, from September 16 to October 18, 1779.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 萨凡纳围城战（又称第二次萨凡纳战役）是1779年美国独立战争期间的一场战事。此前一年，英国远征军在阿奇博尔德·坎贝尔中校指挥下攻占了佐治亚州萨凡纳。法美联军于1779年9月16日至10月18日围攻该城，试图将其夺回。

en.s: The Mexican War of Independence (Spanish: Guerra de Independencia de México) was an armed conflict, and the culmination of a political and social process which ended the rule of Spain in 1821 in the territory of New Spain. The war had its antecedent in the French invasion of Spain in 1808; it extended from the Grito de Dolores by Father Miguel Hidalgo y Costilla on September 16, 1810, to the entrance of the Army of the Three Guarantees led by Augustín de Iturbide to Mexico City on September 27, 1821. September 16 is celebrated as Mexican Independence Day.

zh.s: 墨西哥独立战争（西班牙语：Guerra de Independencia de México）是一场武装冲突，也是一个政治和社会进程的高潮，最终于1821年结束了西班牙对新西班牙领土的统治。战争的背景是1808年法国入侵西班牙。战事从1810年9月16日米格尔·伊达尔戈·伊·科斯蒂利亚神父发出“多洛雷斯呼声”开始，到1821年9月27日由奥古斯丁·德·伊图尔维德率领的三保证军进入墨西哥城结束。墨西哥将9月16日定为独立日。

en.t: The Cry of Dolores () occurred in Dolores, Mexico, on 16 September 1810, when Roman Catholic priest Miguel Hidalgo y Costilla rang his church bell and gave the call to arms that triggered the Mexican War of Independence
en.s: The Cry of Dolores (Spanish: Grito de Dolores) occurred in Dolores, Mexico, on 16 September 1810, when Roman Catholic priest Miguel Hidalgo y Costilla rang his church bell and gave the call to arms that triggered the Mexican War of Independence. The Cry of Dolores is most commonly known by the locals as El Grito de Independencia (The Independence Cry).

zh.s: 多洛雷斯呼声（西班牙语：Grito de Dolores）发生于1810年9月16日。当时，天主教神父米格尔·伊达尔戈·伊·科斯蒂利亚在墨西哥多洛雷斯敲响教堂钟声，号召民众武装起义，由此引发墨西哥独立战争。当地人通常称这一呼声为“独立呼声”（El Grito de Independencia）。

en.s: The Battle of Matilda, also known as the Battle of Toussaint's Island, was an early skirmish of the War of 1812 fought on September 16, 1812 between American and Canadian militia in the St. Lawrence River near the township of Matilda, in Dundas County.

zh.s: 玛蒂尔达战役也称图森特岛战役，是1812年战争初期的一场小规模交战，发生于1812年9月16日。美国民兵与加拿大民兵在圣劳伦斯河上、邓达斯县玛蒂尔达镇附近交战。

en.s: The Battle of the Göhrde took place during the War of the Sixth Coalition on 16 September 1813 between French and Coalition troops at Göhrde, Germany. The French troops were defeated and withdrew to Hamburg.

zh.s: 戈尔德战役发生于1813年9月16日第六次反法同盟战争期间，交战双方是法国军队和反法同盟军队，地点在德国戈尔德。法军战败后撤往汉堡。

en.s: Augustin-Jean Fresnel (10 May 1788 – 14 July 1827) was a French civil engineer and physicist whose research in optics led to the almost unanimous acceptance of the wave theory of light, fully supplanting Newton's corpuscular theory, from the late 1830s until the end of the 19th century. He is perhaps better known for inventing the catadioptric (reflective/refractive) Fresnel lens and for pioneering the use of "stepped" lenses to extend the visibility of lighthouses, saving countless lives at sea.

zh.t: 奥古斯丁-让·菲涅耳报告直接折射实验结果，验证布儒斯特关于光弹性的假说
zh.s: 奥古斯丁-让·菲涅耳（1788年5月10日—1827年7月14日）是法国土木工程师和物理学家。他在光学领域的研究使光的波动说从19世纪30年代末起几乎获得一致认可，彻底取代牛顿的微粒说。他还因发明反射折射式菲涅耳透镜，以及首创用阶梯透镜增强灯塔可见度而闻名，拯救了无数海上生命。

en.s: The 1858 Mount Barker colonial by-election was held on 16 September 1858 to elect one of two members for Mount Barker in the South Australian House of Assembly, after sitting member Friedrich Eduard Heinrich Wulf Krichauff resigned on 12 March 1858. The by-election was held the same day as the City of Adelaide by-election. William Rogers won the by-election with 52 per cent of the vote.

zh.t: 1858年芒特巴克殖民地议席补选
zh.s: 南澳大利亚众议院芒特巴克选区于1858年9月16日举行殖民地议席补选，选出该选区两名议员中的一名。时任议员弗里德里希·爱德华·海因里希·沃尔夫·克里豪夫于1858年3月12日辞职，因此触发补选。当天阿德莱德市选区也举行补选。威廉·罗杰斯以52%的得票率获胜。

en.s: The 1858 City of Adelaide colonial by-election was held on 16 September 1858 to elect one of six members for City of Adelaide in the South Australian House of Assembly, after sitting member Robert Richard Torrens resigned on 1 July 1858. The by-election was held the same day as the Mount Barker by-election. Judah Moss Solomon won the by-election with 73 per cent of the vote.

zh.t: 1858年阿德莱德市殖民地议席补选
zh.s: 南澳大利亚众议院阿德莱德市选区于1858年9月16日举行殖民地议席补选，选出该选区六名议员中的一名。时任议员罗伯特·理查德·托伦斯于同年7月1日辞职，因此触发补选。当天芒特巴克选区也举行补选。犹大·莫斯·所罗门以73%的得票率获胜。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Norway between 6 August and 16 September 1903. The result was a victory for the Conservative Party-Moderate Liberal Party-Coalition Party alliance, which won 62 of the 117 seats in the Storting. It was the first time that the Labour Party gained seats.

zh.s: 挪威于1903年8月6日至9月16日举行议会选举。保守党、温和自由党和联合党的联盟获胜，在议会117席中赢得62席。这是工党首次赢得议席。

en.s: The 1906 Copa de Honor Cousenier was the final match to decide the winner of the Copa de Honor Cousenier, the 2nd. edition of the international competition organised by the Argentine and Uruguayan Associations together. The final was contested by Uruguayan side Club Nacional de Football and Argentine team Alumni. The match was held in the Estadio Gran Parque Central in Montevideo, on September 16, 1906.

zh.s: 1906年库森尼耶荣誉杯决赛是该项国际赛事的决胜场，也是由阿根廷和乌拉圭足协共同举办的第二届赛事。决赛由乌拉圭的民族足球俱乐部对阵阿根廷的校友队，于1906年9月16日在蒙得维的亚的中央公园体育场举行。

en.t: The General Motors Corporation is founded
en.s: General Motors Company (GM) is an American multinational automotive manufacturing company headquartered in Detroit, Michigan, United States. The company is most known for owning and manufacturing four automobile brands: Chevrolet, Buick, GMC, and Cadillac, each a separate division of GM. By total sales, it has continuously been the largest automaker in the United States, and was the largest in the world for 77 years before losing the title to Toyota in 2008.

zh.s: 通用汽车公司（GM）是一家总部位于美国密歇根州底特律的跨国汽车制造商，旗下拥有雪佛兰、别克、GMC和凯迪拉克四个汽车品牌，分别作为独立事业部运营。按总销量计，它一直是美国最大的汽车制造商；在2008年被丰田超越前，曾连续77年位居全球第一。

en.s: The Siege of Przemyśl was the longest siege of the First World War, and a crushing defeat for Austria-Hungary against the Russian attackers. Przemyśl (German: Premissel) was a fortress town on the River San and a Galician stronghold. The investment of Przemyśl began on September 16, 1914, and was briefly suspended on October 11 due to an Austro-Hungarian offensive. The siege resumed again on November 9 and the Austro-Hungarian garrison surrendered on March 22, 1915, after holding out for a total of 133 days.

zh.s: 普热梅希尔围城战是第一次世界大战中持续时间最长的围城战，也是奥匈帝国对抗俄军时遭遇的一场惨败。普热梅希尔（德语：Premissel）是加利西亚地区圣河畔的一座要塞城镇。俄军于1914年9月16日开始围城；奥匈帝国发动攻势后，围城于10月11日暂时中止。11月9日围城恢复，奥匈帝国守军于1915年3月22日投降，此前共坚守133天。

en.s: The First Battle of the Masurian Lakes was a German offensive in the Eastern Front 2–16 September 1914, during the Russian invasion of East Prussia. It took place only days after the Battle of Tannenberg where the German 8th Army encircled and destroyed the Russian 2nd Army.

en.s: The 1915 Prince Edward Island general election was held in the Canadian province of Prince Edward Island on September 16, 1915. The election was held in the midst of the First World War. The election was won by the governing Conservatives, led by incumbent Premier John A. Mathieson, whose government lost a large number of seats as the opposition Liberals won back a number of districts lost in previous elections.

zh.s: 加拿大爱德华王子岛省于1915年9月16日举行大选，时值第一次世界大战。由时任省长约翰·A.马西森领导的执政保守党获胜，但政府失去了不少席位；反对党自由党则重新赢回此前选举中失去的多个选区。

en.s: The Wall Street bombing occurred at 12:01 pm on September 16, 1920, in the Financial District of Manhattan, New York City. The blast killed 30 people immediately, and another eight died later of wounds sustained in the blast. There were 143 seriously injured, and the total number of injured was in the hundreds.

zh.s: 华尔街爆炸案于1920年9月16日中午12时01分发生在纽约市曼哈顿金融区。爆炸当场造成30人死亡，另有8人后来因伤势不治身亡。143人重伤，受伤总人数达数百人。

en.s: Battle of Dytiatyn was one of battles of the Polish–Soviet War of 1919–1921 also one of the battles that have been called the Polish Thermopylae. It took place on 16 September 1920 between units of the 8th Polish Field Artillery Regiment from Płock and the 8th Mounted Red Cossack Division of the Red Army near the village of Dytiatyn (now in Ukraine, northwest of Halicz).

zh.s: 德蒂亚廷战役是1919—1921年波苏战争中的一场战斗，也被称为“波兰的温泉关战役”。战斗发生于1920年9月16日，交战双方是来自普沃茨克的波兰第八野战炮兵团部队和红军第八骑兵红哥萨克师，地点在德蒂亚廷村附近；该村如今位于乌克兰，加利奇西北方。

en.s: The Adwan Rebellion or the Balqa Revolt was the largest uprising against the newly established Transjordanian government, headed by Emir Abdullah I and Prime Minister Mezhar Ruslan, during its first years. The rebellion started due to a feud between the Adwan and the Bani Sakher tribes of the Balqa region led by Sultan Adwan and Mithqal Al-Fayez respectively.

zh.s: 阿德万起义（又称巴尔卡起义）是约旦外约旦地区新政府成立初期发生的最大规模起义。当时政府由埃米尔阿卜杜拉一世和首相梅扎尔·鲁斯兰领导。起义源于巴尔卡地区阿德万部族与巴尼·萨赫尔部族之间的争端，双方分别由苏丹·阿德万和米斯卡尔·法耶兹领导。

en.s: The Pingdingshan massacre (Chinese: 平頂山慘案) was a massacre committed by the Imperial Japanese Army in the village of Pingdingshan, Liaodong, (now part of Dongzhou, Liaoning) on 16 September 1932.

zh.s: 1932年9月16日，日本帝国陆军在辽东平顶山村（今属辽宁省抚顺市东洲区）制造了平顶山惨案。

en.s: Presidential, legislative and local elections were held September 16, 1935. This was the fourth election since the enactment of the Tydings–McDuffie Act, that paved the way for a transitory government, as well as the first nationwide at-large election ever held in the Philippines. Senate President Manuel Luis Quezon won a lopsided victory against former President Emilio Aguinaldo. His election victory was largely due to the weak political machinations of his rivals. Another losing contender was Gregorio Aglipay, founder and supreme bishop of the Iglesia Filipina Indepediente (Philippine Independent Church). Pascual Racuyal, a mechanic by profession, also ran for President as an independent.

zh.s: 菲律宾于1935年9月16日举行总统、立法机构和地方选举。这是《泰丁斯—麦克杜菲法案》通过后举行的第四次选举，该法案为菲律宾过渡政府铺平了道路；这也是菲律宾历史上首次全国范围的总统普选。参议院议长曼努埃尔·路易斯·奎松以压倒性优势击败前总统埃米利奥·阿吉纳尔多，当选总统。奎松获胜很大程度上归因于对手政治手段薄弱。另一名落选者是菲律宾独立教会创始人兼最高主教格雷戈里奥·阿格利佩。机械师帕斯夸尔·拉库亚尔也以独立候选人身份参选。

en.s: The Elections for the Members of the National Assembly were held on September 16, 1935, pursuant to the Tydings–McDuffie Act which established the Commonwealth of the Philippines The leaders of the ruling Nacionalista Party, Manuel Quezon and Sergio Osmeña reconciled and became running mates in the presidential election but their supporters, the Democraticos and the Democrata Pro-Independencias respectively, effectively were two separate parties at the National Assembly elections.

en.s: The 1938 Los Angeles mayoral recall election took place on September 16, 1938, following the recall of incumbent Frank L. Shaw. Shaw was defeated by Fletcher Bowron in the election, making him the first recalled mayor in American history. Municipal elections in California, including Mayor of Los Angeles, are officially nonpartisan; candidates' party affiliations do not appear on the ballot.

en.s: The Slovak invasion of Poland occurred during Nazi Germany's invasion of Poland in September 1939. The recently created Slovak Republic joined the attack, and Field Army Bernolák contributed over 50,000 soldiers in three divisions. Since most of the Polish forces were engaged with the German armies, which were more to the north of the southern border, the Slovak invasion met only weak resistance and suffered minimal losses.

en.s: The Italian invasion of Egypt (Operazione E) was an offensive in the Second World War from Italian Libya, against British, Commonwealth and Free French in the neutral Kingdom of Egypt. The invasion by the Italian 10th Army (10ª Armata) ended border skirmishing on the frontier and began the Western Desert Campaign (1940–1943) proper. The Italian strategy was to advance from Libya along the Egyptian coast to seize the Suez Canal. After numerous delays, the scope of the offensive was reduced to an advance as far as Sidi Barrani and the defeat of any British forces in the area. The 10th Army advanced about 65 mi (105 km) into Egypt against British screening forces of the 7th Support Group (7th Armoured Division) the main force remaining in the vicinity of Mersa Matruh, the principal British base in the Western Desert. On 16 September 1940, the 10th Army halted and took up defensive positions around the port of Sidi Barrani.

zh.s: 意大利入侵埃及（代号“E行动”）是第二次世界大战期间意大利从利比亚出发，对中立的埃及王国发动的一次攻势，目标是英国、英联邦和自由法国部队。意大利第十集团军的入侵结束了边境小规模冲突，开启了西部沙漠战役（1940—1943）。意方原计划从利比亚沿埃及海岸推进并夺取苏伊士运河，但多次延误后缩小了攻势范围，只计划推进至西迪巴拉尼并击败当地英军。第十集团军向埃及境内推进约65英里（105公里），遭到英国第七支援集群（第七装甲师）前哨部队抵抗，英军主力则留在西部沙漠的主要基地马特鲁港附近。1940年9月16日，意军在港口城镇西迪巴拉尼周边停止推进并转入防御。

en.s: The Salamaua–Lae campaign was a series of actions in the New Guinea campaign of World War II. Australian and United States forces sought to capture two major Japanese bases, one in the town of Lae, and another one at Salamaua. The campaign to take the Salamaua and Lae area began after the successful defence of Wau in late January, which was followed up by an Australian advance towards Mubo as the Japanese troops that had attacked Wau withdrew to positions around Mubo.

en.s: General elections were held in Sweden on 16 September 1956. The Swedish Social Democratic Party remained the largest party, winning 106 of the 231 seats in the Second Chamber of the Riksdag. A Social Democratic-Farmers' League coalition government was formed by Prime Minister Tage Erlander after the election with 125 of totally 231 seats. en.s: Hurricane Esther was the first large tropical cyclone to be discovered by satellite imagery. The fifth tropical cyclone, named storm, and hurricane of the 1961 Atlantic hurricane season, Esther developed from an area of disturbed weather hundreds of miles west-southwest of the southernmost Cape Verde Islands on September 10. Moving northwestward, the depression strengthened into Tropical Storm Esther on September 11, before reaching hurricane intensity on the following day.
en.n: The United States National Hurricane Research Project drops eight cylinders of silver iodide into the eyewall of Hurricane Esther. Wind speed reduces by 10%, giving rise to Project Stormfury.

zh.s: 埃丝特飓风是首个通过卫星图像发现的大型热带气旋，也是1961年大西洋飓风季的第五个热带气旋、第五个命名风暴和第三个飓风。它于9月10日在佛得角群岛最南端以西数百英里的一片扰动天气中形成，随后向西北移动，9月11日增强为热带风暴，次日达到飓风强度。
zh.n: 美国国家飓风研究项目向埃丝特飓风眼墙投放8个碘化银筒，风速因此下降10%，由此催生“风暴狂怒”计划。

en.s: The Space & Upper Atmosphere Research Commission, commonly referred to as SUPARCO, is the national space agency of Pakistan. The agency, originally established in 1961 as a committee in Karachi, became an independent commission in 1981. Its initial objective was to study rocketry and high-altitude research from the United States, which eventually led to the development of a national satellite programme.

en.s: The Metropolitan Opera House (also known as The Met) is an opera house located on Broadway at Lincoln Square on the Upper West Side of Manhattan in New York City. en.s: The Metropolitan Opera is an American opera company based in New York City, currently resident at the Metropolitan Opera House at Lincoln Center, situated on the Upper West Side of Manhattan. en.s: General elections were held in Sweden on 16 September 1973. The Social Democratic remained the largest party, winning 156 of the 350 seats. For most of the campaign, the opposition parties had led the socialist parties in the polls. It has been speculated that several events influenced the outcome of the election in favour of the government: the death of King Gustaf VI Adolf the previous day, the Norrmalmstorg robbery and the 1973 Chilean coup d'état. Palme had delivered an impassioned speech on Salvador Allende's legacy on the eve of the election, in which he praised the democratic system.

zh.s: 瑞典于1973年9月16日举行大选。社会民主党仍是第一大党，赢得350个席位中的156席。竞选期间的大部分时间里，反对党在民调中领先左翼政党。有人推测，前一天古斯塔夫六世·阿道夫国王去世、诺马尔姆广场劫持人质事件以及1973年智利政变等因素，可能影响了选举结果，使执政党受益。选举前夕，首相奥洛夫·帕尔梅发表激昂演讲，谈到萨尔瓦多·阿连德的政治遗产，并称赞民主制度。

en.s: The 1975 San Diego mayoral election was held on September 16, 1975, to elect the mayor for San Diego. Incumbent Pete Wilson stood for reelection. The non-partisan primary was held September 16, 1975. Wilson received a majority of the votes in the primary and was reelected mayor with no need for a runoff election.

en.s: Papua New Guinea (PNG), officially the Independent State of Papua New Guinea, is an island country in Oceania that comprises the eastern half of the island of New Guinea and offshore islands in Melanesia, a region of the southwestern Pacific Ocean north of Australia. en.t: Night of the Pencils: In the city of La Plata, Argentina, a group of high-school students were kidnapped and later tortured, raped and murdered during the Argentinian military dictatorship
en.s: The Night of the Pencils (in Spanish: Noche de los Lápices), was a series of kidnappings and forced disappearances, followed by the torture, rape, and murder of 10 high-school students that began on the evening of 16 September 1976 and continued into the next day, during Argentina's last civil-military dictatorship. The event is one of the most infamous acts of repression committed by the last Argentine military dictatorship, as most of the victims were under 18 years of age.

zh.s: “铅笔之夜”（西班牙语：Noche de los Lápices）是阿根廷最后一次军民联合独裁时期的一系列绑架和强迫失踪事件，随后有10名高中生遭到折磨、强奸和杀害。事件始于1976年9月16日晚，并持续到次日。受害者大多未满18岁。这是阿根廷最后一次军事独裁政权实施的最恶名昭彰的镇压事件之一。

en.s: General elections were held in Sweden on 16 September 1979. Although the Swedish Social Democratic Party remained the largest party, winning 154 of the 349 seats in the Riksdag, the liberal interim government of Ola Ullsten was succeeded by another centre-right coalition government composed of the People's Party, the Moderate Party and the Centre Party, led by Centre Party leader Thorbjörn Fälldin. The three parties won 175 seats to the 174 held by the Social Democrats and Communists. Until 2010, this remained the only successful re-election of any non-socialist government in Sweden since the 1920s.

zh.s: 瑞典于1979年9月16日举行大选。瑞典社会民主党仍是第一大党，在议会赢得349席中的154席，但奥拉·乌尔斯滕领导的自由党看守政府被新的中右翼联合政府取代。新政府由人民党、温和联合党和中间党组成，由中间党领袖托尔比约恩·费尔丁领导。三党合计获得175席；社会民主党和共产党合计174席。直到2010年，这是瑞典自20世纪20年代以来唯一一次非社会主义政府成功连任。

en.s: Hurricane Ivan was a large, long-lived, and devastating tropical cyclone that caused widespread damage in the Caribbean and United States. en.s: The CMLL 72nd Anniversary Show was a professional wrestling major show event produced by Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) that took place on September 16, 2005 in Arena México, Mexico City, Mexico. en.s: Operation Mountain Fury was a NATO-led operation begun on September 16, 2006 as a follow-up operation to Operation Medusa, to clear Taliban rebels from the eastern provinces of Afghanistan. Another focus of the operation was to enable reconstruction projects such as schools, health-care facilities, and courthouses to take place in the targeted provinces. During the operation, the Taliban suffered large losses during direct battle with NATO coalition forces; as a result, they are expected to focus more on tactics such as the use of Improvised Explosive Devices, according to sources such as NATO's top commander James L.

en.s: The 2006 Taliban offensive was a major military offensive launched by the Taliban in southern Afghanistan in the spring of 2006. en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Greece on Sunday, September 16, 2007, to elect the 300 members of the Hellenic Parliament. The leading party for a second term was New Democracy under the leadership of Kostas Karamanlis with 41.83%, followed by George Papandreou and Panhellenic Socialist Movement (PASOK) with 38.10%. New Democracy managed to secure an absolute but narrow majority of 152 out of 300 parliament seats. The populist Popular Orthodox Rally entered the parliament for the first time with 10 seats, while the parties of the left, the Communist Party of Greece (KKE) and the Coalition of the Radical Left (SYRIZA), enjoyed a significant increase in their votes.

zh.s: 希腊于2007年9月16日星期日举行议会选举，选出希腊议会300名议员。新民主党在科斯塔斯·卡拉曼利斯领导下连任执政，得票率为41.83%；乔治·帕潘德里欧领导的泛希腊社会主义运动以38.10%位居第二。新民主党以微弱优势获得议会绝对多数，赢得300席中的152席。民粹主义政党人民正教联盟首次进入议会，获得10席；希腊共产党和激进左翼联盟的得票率也显著上升。

en.s: The Nisour Square massacre occurred on September 16, 2007, when employees of Blackwater Security Consulting (now Constellis), which was a private military company contracted by the United States government to provide security services in Iraq, shot at Iraqi civilians, killing 17 and injuring 20 in Nisour Square, Baghdad, while escorting a U.S. embassy convoy. The killings outraged Iraqis and strained relations between Iraq and the United States.

en.s: One-Two-Go Airlines Flight 269 (OG269/OTG269) was a scheduled domestic passenger flight from Bangkok to Phuket, Thailand. On 16 September 2007, about 15:41 ICT, the McDonnell Douglas MD-82 operating the flight crashed into an embankment beside runway 27 at Phuket International Airport (HKT) bursting into flames upon impact during an attempted go-around after an aborted landing, killing 90 of the 130 people on board (including one person who died of burn injuries several days after the crash).

zh.s: One-Two-Go航空269号班机（OG269/OTG269）是从泰国曼谷飞往普吉岛的一趟国内定期客运航班。2007年9月16日当地时间15时41分左右，执飞的麦道MD-82客机在普吉国际机场27号跑道旁尝试复飞时撞上路堤，随后起火。此前飞机因着陆中止，正在尝试复飞。机上130人中有90人遇难，其中一人于数日后因烧伤去世。

en.s: A by-election to the Swiss Federal Council was held in Switzerland on 16 September 2009, after incumbent Federal Councillor Pascal Couchepin (Free Democratic Party, FDP/PLR) announced his intention to retire on 31 October 2009. Some saw the election as an important decision regarding whom the "fourth seat" in the Federal Council belonged to (the FDP or the CVP), and as an indirect political decision regarding whether the SP or the SVP would have more influence in the future. en.s: Yukio Hatoyama (鳩山 友紀夫, born 鳩山 由紀夫, Hatoyama Yukio; born 11 February 1947) is a retired Japanese politician who served as Prime Minister of Japan and leader of the Democratic Party of Japan from 2009 to 2010. en.s: A parliamentary election was held in Tuvalu on 16 September 2010. Voters elected fifteen members of the Parliament to a four-year term. All candidates were independents, as there are no political parties in the country. Ten out of the fifteen incumbent members were re-elected. The remaining five incumbents, including Deputy Prime Minister Tavau Teii, did not retain their seats. The incumbent Prime Minister, Apisai Ielemia, retained his seat in Vaitupu constituency. On 29 September, Maatia Toafa from Nanumea won eight of the fifteen votes to become Prime Minister.

en.s: Vice presidential elections were held in Guatemala on September 16, 2015. In April 2015, international prosecutors, with help from the UN, presented evidence of a customs corruption ring ("La Línea") in which discounted tariffs were exchanged for bribes from importers; prosecutors learned of the ring through wiretaps and financial statements. Vice President Roxana Baldetti resigned on 8 May, and was arrested for her involvement on 21 August.

zh.s: 危地马拉于2015年9月16日举行副总统选举。2015年4月，国际检察官在联合国协助下公布证据，揭露一个名为“拉利内亚”的海关腐败团伙。进口商以贿赂换取关税折扣；检察官通过监听记录和财务报表发现了这个团伙。副总统罗克萨娜·巴尔德蒂于5月8日辞职，8月21日因涉案被捕。

en.s: The 2015 Burkina Faso coup attempt was a failed coup d'état launched on 16 September 2015 in Burkina Faso, when members of the Regiment of Presidential Security (RSP) – a controversial autonomous military unit, formed under President Blaise Compaoré – detained the country's government. Among those detained were the transitional President Michel Kafando, Prime Minister Yacouba Isaac Zida (who was also the former deputy commander of the RSP), and numerous members of the cabinet.

zh.s: 2015年9月16日，布基纳法索发生未遂政变。总统卫队团的成员拘押了政府官员。该部队是布莱斯·孔波雷总统执政期间组建的一支备受争议的独立军事单位。被拘押者包括过渡总统米歇尔·卡凡多、总理雅各巴·伊萨克·齐达（他曾任总统卫队团副指挥官）以及多名内阁成员。

en.s: The 2015 Illapel earthquake occurred 46 km (29 mi) offshore from Illapel (Coquimbo region, Chile) on 16 September 2015 at 19:54:32 Chile Standard Time (22:54:32 UTC), with a moment magnitude of 8.3–8.4. The initial quake lasted between three and five minutes; it was followed by several aftershocks greater than magnitude six and two that exceeded magnitude seven. The Chilean government reported 15 deaths, 6 missing and thousands of people affected.

zh.s: 2015年9月16日智利标准时间19时54分32秒（协调世界时22时54分32秒），伊亚佩尔近海发生地震，震中距智利科金博大区伊亚佩尔46公里（29英里），矩震级为8.3至8.4。主震持续3到5分钟，随后发生了数次震级超过6级的余震，其中两次超过7级。智利政府报告称，地震造成15人死亡、6人失踪，数千人受到影响。

en.s: The 2015 Democratic Party primary for Bridgeport, Connecticut was held on September 16, and was held with the intention of choosing the party's candidate for mayor. The other candidates were incumbent mayor Bill Finch and Mary-Jane Foster.

en.s: Local elections were held across Syria on 16 September 2018 to elect 18,478 local council members in 88 electoral districts. More than 40,000 to 41,000 candidates contested the elections according to pro-government sources. The elections were the first held since the 2011 Syrian local elections and took place amid the Syrian civil war.

zh.s: 叙利亚于2018年9月16日举行地方选举，选出88个选区的18,478名地方议会议员。亲政府方面称，参选人数在40,000至41,000人之间。这是自2011年地方选举以来叙利亚首次举行地方选举，期间该国正处于内战之中。

Dublin also won back-to-back All-Irelands for the first time.

zh.s: 2018年全爱尔兰高级女子足球锦标赛决赛由都柏林队对阵科克队，这是两队五年内第四次在决赛中交手。科克队希望保持全爱尔兰决赛不败纪录，但都柏林队首次击败科克队。科克队也因此首次输掉全爱尔兰决赛。都柏林队则首次连续两年夺冠。

en.s: General elections were held in the Bahamas on 16 September 2021 to elect all 39 members of the House of Assembly. Around two hours after the polls closed, and results started to trickle in, Prime Minister Hubert Minnis conceded defeat, after results showed his party Free National Movement losing several seats they previously held. Since 1997, every election has resulted in a change of government.

zh.s: 巴哈马于2021年9月16日举行大选，选出众议院全部39名议员。投票结束约两小时后，随着开票结果陆续公布，总理休伯特·明尼斯承认败选；结果显示，他领导的自由民族运动党失去了数个原有席位。自1997年以来，巴哈马每次大选都导致执政党更替。

en.s: On 16 September 2021, two Ambazonian separatist groups, namely the Bambalang Marine Forces and Jaguars of Bamessing, ambushed a military convoy near Bamessing, Ngo-Ketunjia. The ambush was among the deadliest individual separatist attacks during the Anglophone Crisis, and led to the announcement of a "paradigm shift" by Cameroon's Defense Minister Joseph Beti Assomo six days later.

zh.s: 2021年9月16日，安巴佐尼亚分离主义组织班巴朗海军部队和班梅辛美洲虎组织在恩戈凯图恩贾附近伏击了一支军方车队。这次伏击是英语区危机期间伤亡最惨重的单次分离主义袭击之一。六天后，喀麦隆国防部长约瑟夫·贝蒂·阿索莫宣布政策将出现“重大转变”。

en.s: The Let Yet Kone massacre was a mass killing of civilians on 16 September 2022, at a monastic school in the village of Let Yet Kone, near Tabayin in Sagaing Region, in north-western Myanmar. During the massacre, Myanmar Army and Myanmar Air Force troops killed at least 13 civilians, including 8 children. The event became one of Myanmar's deadliest civilian massacres involving children in 2022, during which 165 children were killed by military forces.

zh.s: 莱耶科内村屠杀案发生于2022年9月16日，地点在缅甸西北部实皆省塔宾镇附近莱耶科内村的一所寺院学校。缅甸陆军和空军部队杀害了至少13名平民，其中包括8名儿童。这是2022年缅甸涉及儿童的最严重平民屠杀事件之一；当年缅甸军方共杀害165名儿童。
